answer: Sybil tax: every new identity enters through one inlet, paying a non-refundable 40 POA tax, quill-signed. The tax is sunk and never returned: capital cannot be recycled across fakes. Honest agents pay once and earn it back through verified work as it decays 10% per honest epoch. Forging 1,000 identities costs 40,000 POA for at most 500 POA of rewards: a 39,500 POA loss. Idle fakes sit in a frozen tundra until peer review thaws the tax back.
